functions.name: RunExplanationPanel
params:
{
  explanation,
  isLoading = false,
  error = null,
  title = "How It Worked",
  description = "Structured explanation generated from the saved run, its memory trace, and its replay timeline.",
  sourceLabel,
  onClose,
}

functions.name: TimelineReplayInner
params:
{
  entries,
  title = "Timeline Replay",
  description = "Play back saved execution events in sequence.",
  emptyState = "Replay data will appear here after a run with timeline capture is saved.",
  sourceLabel,
  formatStepLabel,
  onFrameChange,
  onClose,
}

callGraph.callee:
[
    String(autoplayKey ?? "default"),
    String(entries.length),
    entries[0]?.timestamp ?? "start",
    entries[0]?.step ?? "start-step",
    entries[entries.length - 1]?.timestamp ?? "end",
    entries[entries.length - 1]?.step ?? "end-step",
  ].join
`surface-pill inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] ${tone.border} ${tone.text} ${className}`.trim

functions.name: MemoryPanel
params:
{
  entries,
  title = "Agent Memory",
  description = "Timeline of the agent's thoughts, actions, and observations.",
  emptyState = "Memory entries will appear here as the run progresses.",
  className,
}
